entries.title: Crewmates stop asking about work you already allowed
entries.body: A crewmate fixes what its own change needs to pass without asking you first, including after you approve a plan. When one of your standing directions says a step needs no consent, a crewmate takes that as your consent. When the first mate is unsure, it reads what is already recorded and asks you only what only you can decide.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the first mate and crewmates ask you on a card, not a view or control.
